nom: Philosophy Dose of Wisdom Bouncy Skin Reactivating Serum

segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including rosacea and acne-prone sensitive skin, mostly report no burning, no breakouts and added hydration, though one reviewer's sinuses ran and her skin burned and itched from the fragrance.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one described as acne-prone and sensitive, report deep hydration and no irritation, though one felt she still needed extra moisturizer to get through the day.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their fifties and sixties report brighter under-eyes, reduced puffiness, and skin that feels more supple, with one saying she wasn't expecting miracles but was still satisfied.

concerns.aging: Reviewers report firmer, plumper skin, a more even tone, and visibly reduced fine lines and wrinkles around the eyes and mouth with regular use; one reviewer wished it plumped a little more and another said it made no difference to her hereditary dark circles.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe hydrated, soft, nourished skin after use, including several with dry skin; one reviewer found the bundled moisturizer insufficient overnight and woke up with skin that still felt dry.
concerns.redness: The few reviewers who mention redness or rosacea say the serum did not burn or aggravate their skin and report no new redness.
concerns.spots: One reviewer with uneven tone reports the vitamin C brightened her complexion and evened out discoloration, and another separately noticed a more even complexion.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers who describe themselves as acne-prone or as breaking out from most products report no new breakouts and no clogged pores from this serum; no reviewer reports it causing blemishes.

aspects.libelle: Fragrance caused burning and sinus irritation
Can pill when layered with makeup or sunscreen
Elegant, gift-ready packaging with travel sizes
Small container size relative to the price

extraits.titre: Dose of Wisdom Bouncy Skin Reactivating Serum
extraits.texte: Really wanted to love this serum because I was told it's scientifically proven to make a difference. Unfortunately it has a fragrance that made my sinuses begin to run. Also, I have sensitive skin and this made my skin burn and itch.

This serum is worth it all day. I tried it in store and it had the rarer mark of a good quality product that really hydrates many layers into the skin, which is a huge deal for someone with drier skin like myself, especially in the winter. If you pair this with the hope in a jar exfoliating cream (rub it on and the dead skin sloughs right off with the cream). This serum/exfoliate combo is better than average facials. *This isnt the duo exfoliating package that has the scrub and Activating cream i dont want to confuse people. These are separate items. I also use the décolletage cream as well and i use the miracle pump for that area (not the jars those are too heavy/greasy for me). This one looks like a bottle of conditioner but its for your chest. Im pleasantly surprised by these particular products from the philosophy line. Those are the standouts imo!

This is such a beautiful gift set! The moisturizing cream is amazing for dry skin. I have acne-prone, sensitive dry skin and this has done nothing but wonders for my skin as well approach colder months. The formula is rich and creamy, but doesn't clog my pores or cause breakouts. I've been really impressed with how it preforms and plan to purchase more in the future. The set is really nice because it also includes a travel size I can take with me when I go on trips. Highly recommend to anyone who needs a moisture boost & has sensitive or dry skin!!

extraits.titre: The best moisturizing serum for sensitive skin!
extraits.texte: Philosophy dose of wisdom bouncy skin reactivating serum is my absolute favorite serum. As someone who breaks out from everything, this product does not do this. I suffer from rosacea and this does not burn my skin and provides a little extra hydration. It also smells amazing and comes in a glass bottle with dropper.

I've been a philosophy gal for a long time! I switched to this serum as my skin matured, and I have not been disappointed! Goes on smooth, my skin drinks it in, great results. I layer it with my moisturizer, and my skin is supple and beautiful!

Just as the title suggests. After using the sample, it fulfilled what I was looking for. My age is 67 (loud & kinda proud). I'm not expecting miracles because I was a sun-worshipper & cleaned my face with warm tap water & a cloth. But I know what I know & am enjoying this product.

I've been using Philosophy's Dose of Wisdom Reactivating Serum morning and night for a few weeks now, and I'm absolutely in love! This serum has truly transformed my skin. The noticeable firming and plumping effects are incredible. My skin feels more youthful and resilient. I've also noticed a significant improvement in my skin tone. The vitamin C in the formula has brightened my complexion and evened out any discolouration. The patented Vitality Booster and hyaluronic acid work wonders in hydrating and plumping my skin. I wake up each morning with a refreshed and dewy complexion. I highly recommend this serum to anyone looking to improve their skin's appearance. It's a game-changer!

reserve: Many of these reviews describe the multi-product gift set (serum plus eye cream and/or moisturizer) rather than isolating effects to the serum alone, so some reported benefits may reflect the full routine rather than the serum specifically.
